name: com.onelobby.unity
description: OneLobby for Unity: lobbies with join codes, WebRTC peer-to-peer data channels, lockstep or raw netcode, text chat and voice, and hosting by IP with a join code (no server). Thin Unity plumbing (UnityTransport, UnityVoiceAudio, OneLobbyRunner) over the engine-agnostic OneLobby.Core, OneLobby.DataChannel (libdatachannel) and OneLobby.Direct.

samples.description: One script with an IMGUI menu: Host, Join by code, send a reliable message, hold V to talk.
No lobby needed: pick a microphone (switches live), watch the level meter, and hear yourself through Opus loopback.
